example: Some school programmes help shy students speak more confidently; a case in point is the school’s mentoring programme.
exampleZh: 有些學校計劃能幫助害羞的學生更有自信地說話；學校的師友計劃便是一個例證。

examples.en: Some school programmes help shy students speak more confidently; a case in point is the school’s mentoring programme.

examples.highlight: Some school programmes help shy students speak more confidently; a case in point is the school’s mentoring programme.

rules.zh: 正確的固定表達是 a case in point，不要把 in 改成其他介詞，也不要寫成 case and point。
rules.en: The fixed expression is “case in point” Do not write: case and point case on point case at point The correct expression is: a case in point

rules.zh: 這個表達通常要配合一個較概括的觀點，而後面的例子則用來支持或解釋該觀點。
rules.en: “A case in point” must support a point The expression normally follows or accompanies a general statement. General point: Some school programmes help shy students speak more confidently. Supporting example: The school’s mentoring programme is a case in point.

rules.zh: 冒號後面的資料只是補充證據，並不是固定表達的一部分。
rules.en: Extra details are optional extensions The core sentence is complete: The reading club is a case in point. You may add evidence after a colon: The reading club is a case in point: it doubled library visits.

rules.zh: 形容詞必須放在 case 前面；clear、good、classic、striking 及 another 都可放在 case in point 之前修飾例證。不可把形容詞放在 case 後面，也不可插入 in point 之間。
rules.en: Adjectives come before “case” a clear case in point a good case in point a classic case in point a striking case in point another case in point a case clear in point a case in clear point

rules.zh: 提及兩個或以上的例證時，要把 case 改為複數 cases，寫成 cases in point；in point 保持不變，不可誤寫成 case in points。
rules.en: Use “cases in point” for two or more examples Singular: The clinic is a case in point. Plural: The two clinics are cases in point.

rules.zh: 本練習的目標是 a case in point，意思是「一個切合的例證」。the case in point 通常指正在討論的那個特定案例，所指和溝通功能不同，因此不作為本課的主要答案。
rules.en: “The case in point” is not the main target This exercise focuses on: a case in point The case in point may refer to the particular case currently being discussed, so it does not always have the same teaching function.

benefits.zh: 這個表達能讓讀者知道，你所提出的例子並非隨意加入，而是直接用來支持前面的觀點。
benefits.en: It shows exactly why an example is being mentioned The expression tells the reader that the example is not random. It directly supports the point you have just made.

benefits.zh: 你可以先提出一個概括觀點，再加入一個具體例證，令解釋更清楚和更有根據。第二句更清楚表示，師友計劃正是支持前述觀點的例證。
benefits.en: It connects a general idea with real evidence You can first make a broad statement and then give one particular example that proves or explains it. Compare: Some school programmes help shy students. The mentoring programme is an example. Some school programmes help shy students the mentoring programme is a case in point.

benefits.zh: 只是一般地引入例子；a case in point 則進一步表明，這個例子與前述觀點尤其切合。
benefits.en: It is more precise than repeatedly writing “for example” For example simply introduces an example. A case in point stresses that the example is especially relevant to the point being discussed. For example

benefits.zh: 使用這個表達後，你可以加入數字、結果或具體事實，解釋該例子為甚麼能支持你的觀點。閱讀學會便是一個例證：它令圖書館到訪人次增加了一倍。
benefits.en: It helps you build stronger explanations After introducing a case in point, you can add facts, figures or results to explain why the example matters. The reading club is a case in point: it doubled library visits.

benefits.zh: 這個表達可以放在句子的不同位置，令學生不必每次都以同一方式引入例子。
benefits.en: It gives you several ways to organise a sentence The expression can appear: after the example before the example after provide or present after take, consider or cite after a colon in an advanced supporting phrase.

benefits.zh: 這個表達適合用於作文、報告和簡報，尤其適合用來解釋觀點、支持論點或提出證據。
benefits.en: It is useful in essays, reports and presentations It is especially useful when explaining an opinion, supporting an argument or presenting evidence.
